fact: County Functionality Assessment workshops held between September and December 2021 in the ten counties of the Enhancing Community Resilience and Local Governance Project found that only Maban, Renk and Rubkona reported having any VSAT: in Renk and Rubkona the sole VSAT was the Health Department's and the County Commissioner's office had none, in Maban one of two was at the Office of the Commissioner, and all other counties reported needing VSATs across all departments; the report's recommendations count two counties, Renk and Rubkona, and it gives no national total of counties.
title: ECRP County Capacity Report: Master Report, County Capacity Profiles
publisher: IOM South Sudan, Enhancing Community Resilience and Local Governance Project (ECRP)
